text:
laura: quick Q — I'm on a 4-day trip but taking the first day as personal (staying over a weekend). Can I use the company card for dinners on the two business days only and still claim per‑diem for the other business day? trying to avoid double-claiming.
aj: short answer: per‑diem is prorated to business days only. company pays business meals on the card when you use it. don't claim per‑diem for a meal you charged to the company card. :+1:
laura: ok that helps. if i use personal card for one dinner (personal + networking) can i still claim per‑diem for that full business day?
jen: yes, if you used a personal card for a business meal you can submit the receipt and get reimbursed (or take per‑diem if your policy allows). but you cannot both submit the receipt and take per‑diem for the same meal.
michael: practical flow we recommend: 1) use company card for regular team meals, 2) if it's mixed personal/business, annotate receipt with who attended and percent business, 3) attach receipts in Expensify and pick either "Actuals (receipt)" or "Per‑diem" for that day — not both.
laura: where's the exact step in Expensify? I keep hitting the per‑diem toggle wrong.
jen: in Expensify: go to `New Expense` -> select date -> choose `Meals` -> attach receipt -> under "Reimbursement Type" pick `Actual` or `Per‑diem`. If per‑diem, select the country and it auto-calculates. If actuals, put amount and upload receipt.
laura: got it. what about hotel incidental fees or SIM cards charged on company card during personal days?
aj: hotel incidentals should be on company card only for business nights. SIM & personal incidentals should be personal card and expensed only if approved. if a mobile esim was needed for business days, add a note and receipts.
michael: one more nuance — multi-city trips: per‑diem rates follow the city/date. if you have a personal day in between, we prorate per‑diem to business dates only. example: Mon (personal), Tue/Wed business, Thu travel home = per‑diem applies Tue/Wed.
laura: thanks — any template for the receipt note? manager might ask for justification.
jen: use this short note: `Trip: SF Offsite; Business days: 2026-06-14 to 2026-06-15; Attendees: laura, sam (internal); Purpose: team sync`. put it in the receipt comments field.
laura: perfect. tagging @aj for approval process question — do managers approve per‑diem or only out-of-pocket receipts?
aj: managers approve trips and any reimbursement > $50. Per‑diem is auto-authorized if trip was pre-approved in the travel request. if not pre-approved, manager will need to OK.
expensify-bot: automated note: "Per‑diem will be calculated on submission. Missing receipt detected for 2026-06-14 dinner — please attach or switch to per‑diem."
laura: cool, i'll attach the dinner receipt and mark business where appropriate. thanks all! :raised_hands:
